latestVersion.changelog:
Family Grocery 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Shared family grocery list for multiple members, organized by store with verified addresses.
- Role-based access: admin manages users and store settings, members can add/remove/view items.
- Web search integration for store addresses and item availability, with graceful fallback if unavailable.
- All changes logged with user attribution and timestamps; history viewable on request.
- Requires per-user identity and shared data path configured in OpenClaw memory before use.
